notes: The Bridgeward College's fighting hall (story bible §3.5, §5.16; mw-ju8.13): Sergeant Maud Garrick (npc-garrick) sells lessons, not goods. Four knight techniques from the ADR-0004 chains, priced inside the economy doc's trainer band (100-400 crowns) by tier: Shoulder Barge 100 (a chain's first step), Riposte 175 and Shield Charge 250 (second steps), Disarm 400 (a third step, after Riposte). Every lesson needs its earlier step (no pure-number unlocks, ADR-0004 P1); there are no spells on the list. She holds no stock and no till.
